sec: RCC comparisons, Cushing's m/c cause by age and the APS table · p862

items.q: Match RCC behaviour — 1) VHL-associated RCC  2) Sporadic RCC … A) U/L, elderly, blood-stream spread  B) B/L, young (M = F), lymphatic spread
items.exp: VHL RCC: B/L, young (M=F), lymphatic spread; sporadic: U/L, elderly, blood-stream spread. (Book p862)

items.q: Match tuberous sclerosis vs VHL — 1) TS cysts  2) VHL cysts (m/c)  3) TS renal carcinoma  4) VHL renal carcinoma … A) RCC  B) Cyst in pancreas  C) Cysts in kidney +  D) Angiomyolipoma
items.exp: TS: kidney cysts + angiomyolipoma; VHL: pancreatic cysts (m/c) + RCC. (Book p862)

items.q: Match the m/c cause of Cushing's syndrome by age — 1) Adults  2) Infants  3) Toddlers … A) McCune-Albright syndrome  B) Adrenocortical carcinoma  C) Pituitary adenoma
items.exp: Adults: pituitary adenoma; infants: McCune-Albright; toddlers: adrenocortical carcinoma. (Book p862)

items.q: Match APS type 1 vs type 2 — 1) APS1 age  2) APS2 age  3) APS1 inheritance  4) APS2 inheritance … A) Adult  B) Childhood  C) Polygenic  D) AR
items.exp: APS1: childhood, M=F, AR; APS2: adult, F>M, polygenic. (Book p862)

items.q: APS type 1 is associated with the ___ gene (AIRE), giving autoimmune poly-endocrinopathy with candidiasis & ectodermal dystrophy.
items.exp: APECED gene/AIRE; APS2 with HLA DR3 and DR4. (Book p862)
APS1: anti-21 hydroxylase (Addison's) and anti-interferon antibody; APS2: anti-21 hydroxylase. (Book p862)

items.q: Skin & nail changes are positive in:
items.exp: Skin & nail changes + in APS1, − in APS2; APS1 adds candidiasis, APS2 associates with coeliac disease. (Book p862)

items.q: Match major thyroid manifestations — 1) APS1  2) APS2 … A) Hashimoto's > Graves  B) Graves > Hashimoto's (with hypoparathyroidism in APS1)
items.exp: APS1: Graves > Hashimoto's plus hypoparathyroidism and Addison's; APS2: Hashimoto's > Graves with Addison's. Minor (both): type 1 DM, hypogonadism. (Book p862)

items.q: The additional feature distinguishing APS1 from APS2 is:
opts: Candidiasis in APS1; coeliac disease association in APS2
Coeliac in APS1; candidiasis in APS2
items.exp: APS1 additional = candidiasis; APS2 associated with coeliac disease. (Book p862)
